<script>
const GAME={key:'rushhour'};
const MAX=100,KEY='gp_'+GAME.key;
let prog=0,L=1,over=false;
try{prog=Math.min(MAX,+localStorage.getItem(KEY)||0)}catch(e){}
const qs=s=>document.querySelector(s);
const save=()=>{try{localStorage.setItem(KEY,prog)}catch(e){}};
const rng=s=>()=>{s|=0;s=s+0x6D2B79F5|0;let t=Math.imul(s^s>>>15,1|s);t=t+Math.imul(t^t>>>7,61|t)^t;return((t^t>>>14)>>>0)/4294967296};
const side=x=>Math.max(200,Math.min(innerWidth-20,innerHeight-215-(x||0),720));
const setInfo=h=>{qs('#info').innerHTML=h},say=t=>{qs('#msg').textContent=t||''};
const stop=()=>{if(typeof onStop=='function')onStop()};
function fitMenu(){const s=Math.max(240,Math.min(innerWidth-20,innerHeight-175,640)),g=qs('#grid');g.style.width=g.style.height=s+'px';g.style.fontSize=Math.max(11,s/10*.36)+'px'}
function menu(){
 stop();qs('#play').hidden=true;qs('#menu').hidden=false;qs('#md').hidden=true;
 qs('#bk').style.visibility='hidden';qs('#lv').textContent='';
 qs('#sub').textContent='Đã qua '+prog+'/'+MAX+' màn';
 let h='';for(let i=1;i<=MAX;i++)h+='<button class="'+(i<=prog?'done':i==prog+1?'cur':'lock')+'" data-l="'+i+'"'+(i>prog+1?' disabled':'')+'>'+i+'</button>';
 qs('#grid').innerHTML=h;fitMenu();
}
function play(l){
 stop();L=l;over=false;qs('#md').hidden=true;qs('#menu').hidden=true;qs('#play').hidden=false;
 qs('#bk').style.visibility='visible';qs('#lv').textContent='Màn '+l;
 const b=qs('#board');b.className='';b.removeAttribute('style');b.innerHTML='';b.onclick=b.onpointerdown=b.onpointermove=b.onpointerup=b.onpointercancel=null;
 qs('#ctl').innerHTML='';say('');setInfo('');start(l);
}
function modal(t,x,btns){qs('#mt').textContent=t;qs('#mx').textContent=x;const m=qs('#mb');m.innerHTML='';
 btns.forEach(a=>{const e=document.createElement('button');e.className='b '+(a[2]||'');e.textContent=a[0];e.onclick=a[1];m.appendChild(e)});qs('#md').hidden=false}
function win(x){if(over)return;over=true;if(L>prog){prog=L;save()}stop();
 setTimeout(()=>{if(!qs('#menu').hidden)return;const fin=L>=MAX,bt=[];if(!fin)bt.push(['Màn tiếp ▶',()=>play(L+1),'on']);bt.push(['Chơi lại',()=>play(L)],['Chọn màn',menu]);
  modal(fin?'🏆 Hoàn thành cả 100 màn!':'🎉 Qua màn '+L+'!',x||'',bt)},450)}
function fail(x){if(over)return;over=true;stop();modal('Chưa được',x||'',[['Thử lại',()=>play(L),'on'],['Chọn màn',menu]])}
qs('#grid').onclick=e=>{const b=e.target.closest('button');if(b&&!b.disabled)play(+b.dataset.l)};
qs('#bk').onclick=menu;
addEventListener('resize',()=>{if(!qs('#menu').hidden)fitMenu();else if(typeof relayout=='function')relayout()});

const COL=['#475569','#4b5d73','#536179','#3f4f63','#5a6578','#455468','#4e5a70','#3b4a5f'];
let cars,pos,hist,mv,els,sz,lk;
function rcar(R){const h=R()<.5,l=R()<.7?2:3;return h?{x:R()*(7-l)|0,y:R()*6|0,l,h}:{x:R()*6|0,y:R()*(7-l)|0,l,h}}
function fits(cs,c){const g=new Int8Array(36);cs.forEach(o=>{for(let k=0;k<o.l;k++)g[o.h?o.y*6+o.x+k:(o.y+k)*6+o.x]=1});for(let k=0;k<c.l;k++)if(g[c.h?c.y*6+c.x+k:(c.y+k)*6+c.x])return false;return true}
function grid(cs,p){const g=new Int8Array(36).fill(-1);cs.forEach((c,i)=>{for(let k=0;k<c.l;k++)g[c.h?c.y*6+p[i]+k:(p[i]+k)*6+c.x]=i});return g}
function nbrs(cs,p,fn){const g=grid(cs,p);cs.forEach((c,i)=>{for(const d of[-1,1])for(let s=1;;s++){const q=p[i]+d*s,e=d<0?q:q+c.l-1;if(e<0||e>5)break;if(g[c.h?c.y*6+e:e*6+c.x]>=0)break;fn(i,q)}})}
function bfs(cs,p0,cap){
 cap=cap||30000;const S=[p0],P=[-1],M=[null],seen=new Set([p0.join()]);
 for(let h=0;h<S.length&&S.length<cap;h++){
  const p=S[h];
  if(p[0]==4){const r=[];for(let g=h;P[g]>=0;g=P[g])r.unshift(M[g]);return r}
  nbrs(cs,p,(i,q)=>{const n=p.slice();n[i]=q;const k=n.join();if(!seen.has(k)){seen.add(k);S.push(n);P.push(h);M.push([i,q])}});
 }
 return null
}

function gen(l){return BANK[l-1].map(a=>({x:a[0],y:a[1],l:a[2],h:!!a[3]}))}
function start(l){
 cars=gen(l);pos=cars.map(c=>c.h?c.x:c.y);hist=[];mv=0;lk=false;
 const b=qs('#board');b.className='rh';b.innerHTML='<div class="gl"></div><div class="lane"></div><div class="ex">▶</div>';
 els=cars.map((c,i)=>{const e=document.createElement('div');e.className='car '+(i?'bg':'hero');if(i)e.style.background=COL[(i*5)%COL.length];b.appendChild(e);bind(e,i);return e});
 qs('#ctl').innerHTML='<button class="b" id="u">↶ Hoàn tác</button><button class="b" id="h">💡 Gợi ý</button><button class="b" id="r">🔄 Làm lại</button>';
 qs('#ctl').onclick=e=>{const t=e.target.closest('button');if(!t||over||lk)return;if(t.id=='u'){if(hist.length){pos=hist.pop();mv--;els.forEach((_,i)=>put(i));info()}}else if(t.id=='h')hint();else play(L)};
 relayout();info();say('Xe ĐỎ ❤ là xe của bạn: kéo nó ra cổng xanh ▶. Các xe xám chỉ là vật cản, hãy dời chúng đi.');
}
function info(){setInfo('Số lượt: '+mv)}
function relayout(){const b=qs('#board');if(!b.classList.contains('rh'))return;const s=Math.floor(Math.min(side(0),innerWidth-50)/6)*6;sz=s/6;b.style.width=b.style.height=s+'px';b.style.marginRight='';
 b.querySelector('.ex').style.top=(2.5*sz-14)+'px';const ln=b.querySelector('.lane');ln.style.top=2*sz+'px';ln.style.height=sz+'px';b.style.setProperty('--ey',2*sz+'px');b.style.setProperty('--eh',sz+'px');b.querySelector('.gl').style.backgroundSize=sz+'px '+sz+'px';els.forEach((_,i)=>put(i))}
function put(i,p){const c=cars[i],e=els[i],q=p==null?pos[i]:p;
 e.style.fontSize=sz*.5+'px';e.style.width=(c.h?c.l*sz:sz)-6+'px';e.style.height=(c.h?sz:c.l*sz)-6+'px';
 e.style.left=(c.h?q*sz:c.x*sz)+3+'px';e.style.top=(c.h?c.y*sz:q*sz)+3+'px'}
function bind(e,i){e.onpointerdown=ev=>{
 if(over||lk)return;ev.preventDefault();e.setPointerCapture(ev.pointerId);
 const c=cars[i],g=grid(cars,pos);let lo=pos[i],hi=pos[i];
 while(lo>0&&g[c.h?c.y*6+lo-1:(lo-1)*6+c.x]<0)lo--;
 while(hi+c.l<6&&g[c.h?c.y*6+hi+c.l:(hi+c.l)*6+c.x]<0)hi++;
 const s0=pos[i],p0=c.h?ev.clientX:ev.clientY;let cur=s0;e.classList.add('dr');
 e.onpointermove=m=>{cur=Math.max(lo,Math.min(hi,s0+((c.h?m.clientX:m.clientY)-p0)/sz));put(i,cur)};
 e.onpointerup=e.onpointercancel=()=>{
  e.classList.remove('dr');e.onpointermove=e.onpointerup=e.onpointercancel=null;
  const f=Math.round(cur);
  if(f!=s0){hist.push(pos.slice());pos[i]=f;mv++;info()}
  put(i);
  if(pos[0]==4){lk=true;say('');els[0].classList.remove('dr');put(0,6);setTimeout(()=>{lk=false;win('Xe đỏ đã thoát ra ngoài sau '+mv+' lượt!')},500)}
 }}}
function hint(){
 const r=bfs(cars,pos);if(!r||!r.length){say('Chưa tìm được gợi ý, hãy thử hoàn tác một vài bước.');return}
 const i=r[0][0],d=r[0][1]-pos[i],c=cars[i];
 els[i].classList.add('fl');setTimeout(()=>els[i].classList.remove('fl'),2200);
 say('Gợi ý: kéo xe đang nhấp nháy '+(c.h?(d>0?'sang phải':'sang trái'):(d>0?'xuống':'lên'))+' '+Math.abs(d)+' ô.');
}

menu();
</script></body></html>
